The centrifugal compressor had a design speed of 21,789 ft/s (exit tip speed of 1615 ft/s).
The impeller had 15 blade/splitter pairs with spanwise varying backsweep, lean, and elliptical leading and trailing edges.
The diffuser had 20 vane/splitter pairs with the splitters offset to maximize pressure recovery.
The exit guide vanes (EGVs) had 60 cascade-style airfoils.
The test facility (CE-18) had a maximum capacity of 6000 hp, 60,000 rpm, and 30:1 pressure ratio.
The design intent for the exit corrected flow rate was 2.1 < ṁc,ex < 3.1 lb/s, and the measured value was 2.98 lb/s.
The design intent for the work factor (ΔHo/U2) was 0.60 < ΔHo/U2 < 0.75, and the measured value was 0.793.
The design intent for the diameter ratio (Dmax/D2) was < 1.45, and the measured value was 1.45.
The design intent for the stability margin was 13%, and the measured value was 7.5%.
The measured adiabatic efficiency was 0.822 ± 0.011, compared to the design intent of > 0.88.
The measured polytropic efficiency was 0.855, compared to the design intent of 0.888.
The measured exit Mach number was 0.18, compared to the design intent of 0.15.
The measured exit flow angle was 34.3 degrees, compared to the design intent of 14 degrees.
The diffuser static pressure rise increased from choke to stall, but was lower than the design intent.
The measured impeller exit corrected flow characteristic was lower than the design intent and pre-test CFD predictions.
